intro: How Windows Update installs updates, when it restarts, what it downloads and over which connections, and whether it brings driver updates.

Keep security updates on

Pausing or turning off updates leaves the PC without security fixes. Security Updates Only (Recommended) keeps security updates coming and defers feature updates by a year.

groups.Update Policy: The overall update policy: normal, security updates only, paused for a long time, or turned off.
groups.Delivery & Store: Delivery Optimization, which shares update downloads between PCs, and automatic updates for Microsoft Store apps.
groups.Update Behavior: Early non-security updates, updates for other Microsoft products, restarts and update notifications, metered connections, and driver updates.
